comment: Start, end, layer change and filament change G-code written for SlicerX by hand, per printer family, and the models that use them. It has the shape of gcode.json and is merged with it when the profiles load; a family or model in both files is refused. Edit this file, not gcode.json.

sovol_sv04.start:
; Sovol SV04 in its default auto-park mode: on a tool change the firmware parks the idle carriage at its end of X
G90 ; absolute moves
M83 ; relative extrusion
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 T0 S150 ; keep the nozzles from oozing while homing
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M104 T1 S150
{endif}G28 ; home, both carriages go to their ends
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]} ; heat both nozzles together
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M104 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}
{endif}M109 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]}
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M109 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}
T1 ; prime the right tool along the right edge
G1 Z5 F600
G1 X298 Y10 F3000
G1 Z0.28 F240
G92 E0
G1 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime line
G1 X297.6 F5000
G92 E0
G1 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime line back
G92 E0
G1 Z5 F600
{endif}T0 ; prime the left tool along the left edge
G1 Z5 F600
G1 X2 Y10 F3000
G1 Z0.28 F240
G92 E0
G1 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime line
G1 X2.4 F5000
G92 E0
G1 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime line back
G92 E0
G1 Z2 F600
T[initial_tool] ; the first tool of the print comes out, the other stays parked
sovol_sv04.end:
G1 Z{min(max_layer_z + 2, printable_height)} F600 ; lift off the print
M104 T0 S0
M104 T1 S0
M140 S0
M107
G1 Y{print_bed_max[1] * 0.8} F{travel_speed * 60} ; present the print
G1 Z{min(max_layer_z + 70, printable_height - 10)} F600
M84 X Y E
sovol_sv04.changeFilament:
; The firmware parks the old carriage and brings out the new one on its next move
T[next_extruder]
M109 T[next_extruder] S{if layer_num < 1}{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[next_extruder]}{else}{nozzle_temperature[next_extruder]}{endif} ; wait for the new tool's temperature
